_comment: Checks that are red because of an unfixed product finding. May only shrink. See scripts/process-battery/README.md.

acquire-to-retire: a residual value above the cost is refused
the three-month tool is fully depreciated after three months
nothing more is proposed for a year whose three in-service months are already booked
revaluing above the original cost is refused
book-to-meet: setting hours for a day replaces that day's hours — one window, not one more
the booked 10:00 is no longer offered — 09:00 and 11:00 are
double-booking is refused at the database level: an exclusion constraint, or a lock in the RPC
the legacy book_appointment cannot double-book customer B's hour either
03:00 at night is outside opening hours
a booking on the blocked day is refused
a booking in the past is refused
no live booking exists outside the Tuesday 09–12 window
the phone lookup finds it too
A's cancelled booking cannot be revived on top of K
10:00 is held by exactly one live booking
a completed meeting is terminal — it cannot go back to pending
content-to-conversion: manage_blog_posts update {status} either changes the status or refuses — never a silent "updated"
the scheduled-publish cycle runs with a page due
the due page went live and left the queue
the due ARTICLE went live too ("pages and blog posts")
U unsubscribes with the address in CAPITALS — and really is unsubscribed
the count is the number of confirmed subscribers
mailing the whole list waits for an approval gate, as the skill says it does
W, whose newsletter consent is revoked, is NOT mailed
hire-to-retire: a rejected application cannot be hired
the salary the bridge was given is the salary payroll will pay
Monday to Friday is five days
sick leave can be approved without a "sick allocation"
the colleague who starts in 2040 has no line
the employment contract no longer reads as a live draft
lead-to-customer: lead_pipeline_review accepts its own documented status_filter "qualified"
the deal lands on the person named by lead_email, not on the newest colleague
the duplicate (which has history) is merged into the customer
after the merge ONE lead remains
add_lead recognises the address in another letter case
manage_company get (in the skill's action enum) returns the company
order-to-delivery: a product born with ten has ten on the shelf
eleven units of a product with ten on the shelf is refused
a refused order leaves no order behind
three units sold hold three units, not six
picking five on a line of three is refused
goods held for the order are not short for its own picking
a repeated allocation adds no second line
a picking nobody has picked cannot ship
plan-to-produce: the B bought for this MO are reserved for it
the capitalised labor (150 kr) is debited to inventory in the ledger
the five C it was promised are reserved for it
the five C exist in the warehouse quants
procure-to-pay: goods and bill have met: the interim account is zero
no price variance on a bill at the ordered price
quote-to-cash: an approval request exists and is linked
a quote awaiting approval cannot be sent
sending hands the customer an email with the link
a rejected quote cannot become an invoice
the lines of an issued invoice cannot be rewritten
an issued invoice keeps its total
the deposit is in the books the day it arrives
a payment without the optional reference is accepted
the hours invoice knows who the customer is
the tax_rate the skill accepts is the one applied
a reminder logged as sent was handed to the mail rail
a cancelled invoice leaves no receivable in the books
record-to-report: an entry on an account that does not exist is refused
booking went through the staged-operation envelope
closing went through the staged-operation envelope
an entry that is already reversed cannot be reversed again
one reversal exists for the purchase
the reference column survives the decimal comma
a bank line imported twice exists once
register-to-attend: the visitor surface refuses a third seat on a two-seat webinar
manage_webinar has no side door for registrations
the two-seat webinar holds two registrations
capacity is counted under a lock, so a rush for the last seat seats one person
manage_webinar update cannot walk a completed webinar back to draft
correcting a mis-click does not hand out another +10
registration and attendance are on the leads' activity ledger
A keeps the 15 points the registration gave
B keeps at least the 25 points registration + attendance gave
sign-to-serve: the agreement is linked to its quote and §4 carries the quoted line
exactly one service is born from the signature
the body of a signed agreement cannot be rewritten
an appendix of a signed agreement cannot be rewritten
the signed content still hashes to what the customer signed
a signed agreement cannot be sent for signature again
subscribe-to-renew: a reminder logged as sent reached the mail rail
the upgrade costs the remaining share of the billed period
one period at three seats costs 3 000 kr net, not more
the next invoice honours the recorded credit
support-to-resolution: a reopened case is no longer stamped as resolved
resolving stamps resolved_at and closing stamps closed_at
the redelivered reply is one comment, not two
